method: Current measured local tree plus 1216 remaining undrafted characters at pilot mean card/stroke/manifest bytes, plus support articles beyond the five already drafted at observed mean word/manifest bytes. Manifest entry bytes use actual two-space indent, UTF-8 filenames, quoted SHA and comma/newline. Reused-word corrections already in current tree; unknown future reused corrections excluded. No compression-ratio or inflated-total prediction.

observedIndependentProcessSeconds.limits: Process elapsed times only, not authoring/native/signing overhead or reproducible future time/cost. No credit/billing forecast.

limits: Five support words for twelve deliberately risk-stratified cards is not representative source-row mapping or a full-set lexical forecast. The 512-word scenario is a rounded ratio sensitivity, not a target.
Smallest scenario retains the five already necessary support words but assumes no more; it is a capacity extreme, not an editorial plan. One word per character is also a sensitivity, not a cap.
Pilot has 47 readings for 12 characters; full-set workload is 3303 entries for 1228. Do not extrapolate its rare-reading rate to the whole set.
Future cards, support families, reused passages and accepted corrections may be larger or require smaller review packets. All runtime entry/compressed/inflated/retained guards remain unchanged.
Pilot is not accepted. No later batch authorized past unresolved reading/native/phone gates; README accepted-pilot publication paragraph remains unchanged.
